# PTS: New Daily Operations & New Minerva Plans (Skyline Valley Update)

![PTS: New Daily Operations & New Minerva Plans (Skyline Valley Update)](/uploads/345_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update May 17, 2024] More new Minerva plans

Yesterday Bethesda released a new PTS update. It was already announced in the patch notes that there are new enemies and new locations for daily operations.

New, interesting things came to light in data mining.

## Daily Operations: New Enemies & Locations

- **Fanatic**
in the foundry of The P.I.T.T.
- **Overgrown**
in the aquarium of the Atlantic

## New rewards for daily operations

(German names are not yet available everywhere.)

Rare:

- Blueprint: Steel Bust
- Blueprint: Foundry Smelter

"Unusual":

- Plan: Long Aquarium Signs
- Plan: Atlantic Emblem
- Plan: Aquarium Signs
